title: Manager Supply Chain Planning | Senior Manager
description:
Aqui cada profissional é único!
As nossas pessoas atingem o seu máximo potencial através de treinamentos contínuos e exposição a oportunidades que os fazem sair da zona de conforto, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal.
São estimulados a colaborar e construir relações sólidas através de líderes inspiradores, trabalhando em equipes diversas com o objetivo de inovar, atingindo os melhores resultados. As conquistas são reconhecidas e celebradas, fomentando um ambiente inclusivo e desafiador.
Na PwC construímos confiança na sociedade resolvendo problemas importantes.
Conheça as possibilidades de carreira na PwC Brasil, alinhando o seu propósito ao nosso.

Job Description & Summary

Uma carreira em nossa prática de Consultoria Tecnológica, dentro de serviços de Consultoria Geral, proporcionará a você a oportunidade de ajudar os clientes a aproveitar vantagens essenciais, trabalhando ao lado de líderes empresariais para resolver seus problemas mais difíceis e capturar suas maiores oportunidades. Trabalhamos com algumas das maiores e mais complexas empresas do mundo para compreender os seus problemas e oportunidades comerciais únicos num ambiente em constante mudança. Ajudamos a criar mudanças sustentáveis, estimulando a inovação, desbloqueando possibilidades de dados, navegando pelo risco e pela complexidade regulatória, otimizando negócios e alinhando custos com a estratégia de negócios para criar uma vantagem competitiva.

Como membro da equipe, você trabalhará com os clientes para definir sua visão e planejar como chegar lá. Fornecemos as soluções tecnológicas que as organizações precisam para competir, crescer e construir um legado duradouro de melhoria e desempenho, em parceria com as melhores tecnologias e conjuntos de soluções. Ao ingressar, você ajudará nossos clientes a compreender e evoluir a maneira como alinham a Tecnologia da Informação com sua estratégia de negócios, criam soluções integradas de ponta a ponta e usam aplicativos empresariais para resolver problemas de negócios complexos.

Descrição:

  • Profissional com ampla experiência em Supply Chain, com maior profundidade em Supply Chain Planning.

Superior completo:

description:
Quem somos

Somos uma empresa dedicada à inovação tecnológica, oferecendo uma plataforma SaaS projetada para aprimorar a gestão financeira e contábil dos nossos clientes. Nossa meta é proporcionar uma gestão eficiente e de alto desempenho. Comprometemo-nos a entregar produtos de qualidade excepcional, impulsionados pela nossa busca contínua pela excelência técnica.

Nossa missão é tornar a gestão financeira de alta qualidade acessível a todos, oferecendo análises sofisticadas que transformam a contabilidade e processos financeiros em informações estratégicas para guiar a tomada de decisão.

Do Brasil para o Mundo

A Accountfy é uma empresa brasileira que atende clientes em vários países da América Latina e dos EUA. Temos mais de 500 negócios ativos simultaneamente em nossa base de clientes, incluindo parceiros como Itaú BBA, EY, Ricoh, Grant Thornton, entre outros.

  • Liderar e executar projetos de implantação de software de finanças, desde a análise inicial até a finalização.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos detalhados de implantação, identificando marcos e recursos necessários.
  • Analisar os requisitos de negócios e traduzir essas necessidades em soluções técnicas eficazes.
  • Garantir a correta configuração e integração dos sistemas de software de finanças.
  • Fornecer treinamento e suporte para usuários finais e equipes internas, garantindo uma transição suave para os novos sistemas.
  • Monitorar e relatar o progresso do projeto, garantindo a comunicação eficaz com todas as partes interessadas.
  • Avaliar e documentar a eficácia da implantação, identificando oportunidades de melhoria contínua.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e melhores práticas em sistemas financeiros e tecnologias de implantação.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Necessário ter espanhol fluente ou nativo - será testado em entrevista.
  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Administração ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência com implantação e integração de sistemas complexos de ERP e financeiros por consultoria;
  • Conhecimento em BP, DRE, DFC, DMPL, DVA e outros demonstrativos, incluindo notas explicativas;
  • Experiência na consolidação de dados financeiros de múltiplas fontes e na geração de relatórios financeiros precisos e informativos, incluindo demonstrações financeiras, relatórios de gerenciamento e análises de tendências;
  • Conhecimento avançado em indicadores/KPIs financeiros;
  • Conhecimento e experiência em metodologia tradicional de gerenciamento de projetos e metodologias ágeis;

Nosso Time

Venha ser um Accountfyer!

Venha fazer parte de um time em constante evolução! Estamos ampliando nossos horizontes e em busca de profissionais talentosos e apaixonados por tecnologia para se juntarem a nós nesta jornada emocionante. Faça sua inscrição agora, enviando seu currículo ou perfil do LinkedIn.

title: AI Machine Learning Engineer
description:
The Machine Learning R&D Engineer role is responsible for the design, development and implementation of machine learning solutions to serve our organization. This includes ownership or oversight of projects from conception to deployment with appropriate AWS services, Docker, MLFlow, and others. The role also includes responsibility for following best practices with which to optimize and measure the performance of our models and algorithms against business goals.

Responsibilities:

  • Machine learning model research and development: design, develop and deploy machine learning models for localization and business workflow processes, including machine translation and quality assurance. Utilize appropriate metrics to evaluate model performance and iterate accordingly.
  • Ensure code quality: Write robust, well-documented, and structured Python code.
  • Define and design solutions to machine learning problems: Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and design solutions that meet those needs. Explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Mentorship: Guide junior team members and contribute to a collaborative team environment.

Success indicators of a Machine Learning R&D Engineer:

  • Effective Model Development: success is evident when the models developed are accurate, efficient, and align with project requirements.
  • Positive Team Collaboration: demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with various teams and stakeholders, contributing positively to project outcomes.
  • Continuous Learning and Improvement: a commitment to continuous learning and applying new techniques to improve existing models and processes.
  • Clear Communication: ability to articulate findings, challenges, and insights to a range of stakeholders, ensuring understanding and appropriateness.

Requirements:

  • Excellent, in-depth understanding of machine learning concepts and methodologies, including supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, and classification.
  • Hands-on experience with natural language processing (NLP) techniques and tools.
  • Ability to write robust, production-grade code in Python.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills. Able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience taking ownership of projects from conception to deployment. Ability to transform business needs to solutions.

Nice to have:

  • Experience using Large Language Models in production.
  • High proficiency with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS technologies including EC2, S3, and other deployment strategies. Experience with SNS, Sagemaker a plus.
  • Experience with ML management technologies and deployment techniques, such as AWS ML offerings, Docker, GPU deployments, etc.

Education and Experience:

  • BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics or similar field.
  • Master’s Degree is a plus.
  • 5+ years’ experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role.

Benefits:

  • National public holidays.
  • Vacations: 3 weeks per year.
  • Work laptop provided.

tbo . aims to facilitate global communication by bridging the gap between peoples and cultures, providing simple solutions to complex problems, and outstanding service in 100+ languages.

Company Culture:

tbo. fosters a culture of continuous improvement, creativity, sustainability and community, with a longstanding commitment to providing high-touch human service.

    • Extending the strategic horizon to 5 years in Emerging Markets sites;

    • Clearly understanding commercial ambitions & linking to the Master Plan in Emerging Markets sites;

    • Optimising asset utilisation;

    • Standardisation and development of preferred/strategic suppliers to enable Procurement to leverage scale and relationships for lowest cost & best service;

  • Computer literate including knowledge of web-based systems and comprehensive knowledge of Microsoft Windows suite. Ability to identify engineering solutions which meet the Company's need to maintain or increase competitive advantage, support long term manufacturing strategy, improve profitability, and provide opportunities for future strategic business decision making;

title: Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector
description:
Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional recent graduate as junior Legal Advisor or junior Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical they will have the opportunity to work on a variety of transactional matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as the contracts that underpin global employment, contracting and partnerships. In this appointment we are more focused on ability than experience; the position is open to applicants with a relevant degree, but does not have a requirement for extensive work experience. The successful candidate will work closely with our in-house legal team and colleagues worldwide.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate good commercial judgment as well as being organized, efficient, and capable to provide high quality legal and commercial advice. We are looking for a rigorous work ethic, detailed analysis, conscientiousness, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement.
Location : This role is home based in Europe, the Middle East, Africa or the Americas, with the option of our London office.
The role entails

  • Report to our global general counsel
  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and vendors in many countries across the globe
  • Provide legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical's sales organization
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to support company initiatives
  • Utilize Canonical's contract management system to ensure accurate data is maintained for signed contracts
  • Work with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active license to practice law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-cultural environment
  • Effective both independently and as part of a team
  • A passion for technology evidenced by personal initiatives and projects
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience in commercial transactions, intellectual property, or corporate law
  • Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices
  • Understanding of the open source software community and values
  • Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software
  • Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

title: Gezinsbegeleider complexe problematiek
description:
Hoop en herstel bieden voor jongeren en gezinnen, dat is waar jij als gezinsbegeleider aan meebouwt in gemeente Stichtse Vecht.
Omdat je het belangrijk vindt dat ieder kind thuis kan opgroeien, draag je daar graag aan bij als gezinsbegeleider. Je komt in een leuk en gedreven team. Als gezinsbegeleider houdt je van de uitdaging en de complexe situaties die op je pad kunnen komen en je vindt het mooi om weer perspectief te bieden aan gezinnen. We bieden je de mogelijkheid om jezelf te specialiseren door middel van een opleiding.

Jouw werk doet ertoe

Als gezinsbehandelaar ben je er voor ouders en het kind. Je brengt samen met hen de (vaak complexe) situatie in kaart en stelt doelen. Je stemt af met de wijkteammedewerker (die casusregie voert) begeleidings-/behandelingsgesprekken met ouders, het kind, gezin en hun netwerk. Samen werk je ernaar toe dat ze weer met elkaar verder kunnen. Dat is niet altijd een soepel traject.

Het aansluiten bij het gezin vraagt een goed ontwikkeld analytisch vermogen en sterke communicatieve vaardigheden. Je werk is veelal solistisch, maar er is ondersteuning vanuit een teamcoach, een gedragswetenschapper en collega’s van het specialistisch team. Je hebt kennis en kunde en je vindt het leuk deze te delen met je collega’s. We hebben regelmatig werkoverleg en casuïstiekbesprekingen en je draagt hier graag aan bij. Er is veel afstemming met het gezin en de betrokken medewerkers. Het specialistisch team is stabiel en ervaren.

Het vraagt dus wel iets van jou als professional. Het uiteindelijke doel? Een fijne en veilige opgroeisituatie voor het kind of de jongere. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe.

Dit ga je doen

  • Ondersteuning en begeleiding bieden aan ouders en kinderen in complexe thuissituaties
  • Samen met ouders en/ kind(eren) stel je doelen, legt die vast en ondersteunt het veranderingsproces
  • Zelfstandig begeleidingsgesprekken voeren, observeren en vooruitgang rapporteren
  • Handvatten bieden en een klankbord zijn voor ouders en of jongeren
  • Veiligheid en de ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden van het kind nauwgezet in de gaten houden

Dit vragen we

  • Relevante Hbo-diploma (bijvoorbeeld Social Work of Pedagogiek)
  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie of je voldoet aan de eisen om je op zeer korte termijn te kunnen registreren
  • Tenminste 1 jaar ervaring in de (ambulante) specialistische jeugdhulpverlening. Er is voor ruimte voor een junior in ons team.
  • Rijbewijs B en een auto. Ons hoofdkantoor in Maarssen is tegenover het NS-station en biedt gelegenheid tot gratis parkeren.
  • Het helpt als je al een systemische opleiding hebt gedaan zoals bijvoorbeeld een contextuele opleiding, IAG, casemanagement of MDFT maar dat is geen must. Wel ben je bereid een dergelijke opleiding te volgen en hier snel mee te starten.
  • Het is een pré als je ook trainingen/cursussen hebt gedaan met specialisaties: autisme en/of ADHD begeleiding, gehechtheidsproblematiek, cultuur sensitieve hulp voor gezinnen met migratie achtergrond, complexe puberbegeleiding.
  • Enthousiasme en reflectie- en relativeringsvermogen zijn nodig om je te verwelkomen in ons specialistisch team.

Jouw plek in de organisatie

TIM Stichtse Vecht is in de gemeente Stichtse Vecht verantwoordelijk voor de jeugdhulp, WMO-begeleiding en ondersteuning vanuit de wijkteams. TIM Stichtse Vecht staat voor een Stichtse Vecht waarin iedereen, van jong tot oud, meetelt en meedoet. Lukt dat even niet zo goed? Dan begint passende zorg met luisteren naar de inwoner, zodat je de juiste ondersteuning kunt bieden, dichtbij inwoners en met weinig regeldruk. We stellen daarbij inwoners én medewerkers centraal. Eind 2026 zal Tim Stichtse Vecht stoppen en zal de hulpverlening op een andere wijze worden ingericht. Ga jij die uitdaging aan, dan kom je werken bij TIM Stichtse Vecht in dienst van Timon. Binnen Timon zal er ook na 2026 ruimte zijn voor (gespecialiseerde) jeugdhulpverleners.

Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg schaal 9 vanaf € 3191,69 tot € 4766,96,- afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring
  • Een jaarcontract tussen de 28-36 uur, afhankelijk van wat jij wilt. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dit contract om in een vast dienstverband
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris
  • Een eigen teamcoach die jou helpt met je persoonlijke doelstellingen en ontwikkeling
  • Binnen TIM Stichtse Vecht krijg je een uitgebreid inwerktraject waarin we je koppelen aan een buddy. Daarnaast volg je diverse trainingen en opleidingen gericht op jouw functie.

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra. Dat is voor ons vanzelfsprekend, daar worden we om herkend. Benieuwd hoe Timon omgaat met haar christelijke identiteit? Kijk dan op .

Jij @TIM Stichtse Vecht?

Denk jij dat Tim Stichtse Vecht de organisatie is die bij je past? Solliciteer dan op de vacature. Wil je eerst nog even wat vragen of wil je meer informatie, dan kan je contact zoeken met Carla Verkroost- de Bruijn, teamcoach via 06 21 97 03 24 of met Esther Muijlwijk, teamcoach, op telefoonnummer 06-11104184. Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiter.

Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiter.

Wil je eerst even komen kennismaken en koffiedrinken op onze nieuwe, toegankelijke locatie? Welkom! We gaan graag met je in gesprek op onze hoofdkantoor in Maarssen. Bel de recruiter voor een afspraak met een van de teamcoaches van het specialistisch team.

Als gedragswetenschapper werk je op alle niveaus mee aan goede zorg en ondersteuning aan jongeren en jongvolwassenen en hun gezin. Met jouw skills help je collega’s hun cliënten goed te begeleiden en samen de kwaliteit van maatschappelijke zorg aan jonge moeders en kind te waarborgen. Voor het team Danita in Amsterdam zijn we op zoek naar een gedragswetenschapper voor 16 uur per week. In combinatie met de Gedragswetenschapper Alleenstaande moeders en kind kan je 32 uur per week werken.

Danita betreft twee locaties voor kleinschalig wonen voor (jonge) vrouwen, waarvan sommigen moeders en hun kind(eren). We bieden een veilige plek om tijdelijk te wonen en ondersteuning te krijgen om gefaseerd weer op eigen benen te gaan staan. Binnen Danita staat het gewone leven centraal. Op de locaties wonen tevens omwoners die als goede buur voor de jonge dames aanwezig zijn. Samen met je collega’s ben je verantwoordelijk voor het draaiend houden van de locaties.

Analytisch, inspirerend, daadkrachtig

Als gedragswetenschapper geef jij, samen met de teammanager, duaal sturing aan je team. Hulpverleners hebben de juiste vaardigheden en tools nodig om hun cliënten goed te begeleiden. Jij coacht hen daarbij en bespreekt de kwaliteit van zorg in de werkbegeleidingsgesprekken. Je sluit aan bij de vragen van hulpverleners en denkt mee over casuïstiek. Je traint hen met jouw kennis en ervaring. Je volgt de ontwikkelingen in de wetenschap en in de samenleving. Samen met de afdeling Strategie & Beleid werk je aan doorontwikkeling van zorgconcepten. En in samenwerking met de regiomanager bewaak je de kwaliteit van zorg én de zichtbaarheid van het zorgaanbod bij gemeenten en collega-organisaties. Dat vraagt wat van je. Je bent analytisch, inspirerend en onderzoekend. In acute situaties treed je daadkrachtig op.

Jouw werk doet ertoe!

Als gedragswetenschapper ben je er vooral voor de zorgprofessionals. Samen met de hulpverleners zet je begeleidings- en behandeltrajecten op en houd je deze op de rit. Je werkt veelal alleen in deze functie, mét de mogelijkheid om te sparren met andere gedragswetenschappers in Amsterdam of het land. Bijvoorbeeld als je ergens tegenaan loopt in jouw zorgconcept. De protocollen en richtlijnen maken we op maat voor de specifieke situatie van cliënten. Het mooie is dat je ook invloed hebt op de kwaliteit van zorg in het algemeen. Jouw werk doet ertoe! Wil je meer zien over het werk van onze Gedragswetenschappers, bekijk dan hier het filmpje van Helga één van onze Gedragswetenschappers binnen Timon.

  2. Je werkt samen met ketenpartners rondom een cliënt, zoals de GGD

Susanne, gedragswetenschapper

title: Head of Public Policy, Latin America
description:
Discord is used by over 200 million people every month for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does on our platform: play video games. Over 90% of our users play games, spending a combined 1.5 billion hours playing thousands of unique titles on Discord each month. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to talk and hang out before, during, and after playing games.

As Discord’s Head of Public Policy for Brazil and Latin America, you will be responsible for building trust and finding common ground with policymakers, regulators, and other stakeholders in Brasilia and national capitals across Latin America. This role can be resident in Sao Paulo or Brasilia and will report to the Head of Americas Public Policy.

What you will do

  • Introduce Discord to government policymakers and civil society stakeholders in key markets across the region, including educating decision-makers on our founding vision, our products, and our investments in privacy and safety;
  • Develop and execute a multi-year government advocacy strategy that maps the interests of Discord users and the company’s business goals to the evolving legal and regulatory landscape in those key markets;
  • Identify emerging trends in the regulation of online communications services and build action plans responsive to these trends in coordination with our Legal, Product, and Communications teams;
  • Advocate for Discord’s position on key legislative and regulatory initiatives that will impact our users and our business, balancing direct advocacy with effective leverage from coalitions and associations;
  • Provide context and support for the company’s responses to regulator inquiries;
  • Promote employee awareness and invite employee engagement on our public policy strategy and priorities;
  • Engage in public policy coalitions with peer companies and civil society organizations;
  • Coordinate and drive compelling returns from the company’s partnerships with non-profits and civil society organizations; and
  • Manage the company’s government affairs consultants and advisors in Latin America.

What you should have

  • Sustained (7+ years) professional success at the highest levels of government and/or in strategic public policy advocacy
  • Experience developing and executing public policy advocacy campaigns in Brazil, with experience in other key markets (Mexico, Argentina, Chile) in the region a plus
  • Insight on the policymaking process in key markets throughout the region
  • Commitment to Discord’s mission to be the place where everyone can find belonging before, during and after playing games together online
  • Willingness to travel as necessary within the region, with occasional travel to the U.S. as required

Bonus Points

  • Work experience on technology policy initiatives such as online safety, privacy, cybersecurity, or content moderation, especially in the online gaming space
  • Ability to translate complex technical information into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical audiences
  • Leadership experience with a civil society organization and/or tech company
  • Success building trust and consensus across stakeholders with different perspectives and priorities

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Role Overview

The Senior Risk Manager plays a pivotal role in developing and executing risk-based monitoring strategies, ensuring data quality and integrity in clinical research projects. This position involves cross-functional collaboration to identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the clinical trial lifecycle, supporting the seamless implementation of Risk-Based Study Management (RBSM) principles.

Responsibilities

  1. Provide subject matter expertise for developing and updating the risk-based monitoring strategy tailored to project needs.
  2. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate risks associated with complex indications.
  3. Draft initial risk assessments and support the finalization of Risk Assessment and Categorization Tools (RACT).
  4. Guide Project Managers (PMs) in transferring identified risks to the appropriate tracking systems and ensure ongoing reviews.
  5. Advise on developing functional plans to mitigate risks effectively.
  6. Utilize available tools to conduct remote data reviews and centralized statistical monitoring, identifying risks to data quality and integrity.
  7. Facilitate internal and sponsor reviews of findings, seeking cross-functional support for complex risks and mitigations.
  8. Deliver initial and ongoing training for study teams on risk assessment, centralized monitoring, and risk-based monitoring strategies.
  9. Mentor peers and train new team members on functional delivery, risk evaluation, and action implementation.
  10. Escalate risks or deliverables at risk to the PM, including scope changes.
  11. Provide strategic input on risk characterization and reporting to leadership.
  12. Take on additional responsibilities as required, ensuring qualifications and training align with assigned tasks.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research; Master’s degree or health data sciences degree preferred.
  • Expertise in Good Clinical Practice/ICH E6 (R3) Guidelines and other regulatory requirements.
  • Proficiency in Risk-Based Monitoring strategies, processes, and tools.

Technical Skills

  • Mastery of MS Excel (sorting, filtering, pivot tables).
  • Advanced skills in analytical data visualization tools.
  • Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma and web based RACT tools.

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and statistical understanding.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to anticipate critical issues and develop proactive contingency plans.
  • Skilled in project workflows and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Training, mentoring, and organizational capabilities.

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years in risk management within a clinical research setting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience across clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety, medical monitoring, biometrics, or project management.

Attributes

  • Fluent in English (excellent oral and written).
  • Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels within the organization and with external customers.
  • Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly.
  • Prioritization skills with the ability to plan, monitor, and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands.
  • Excellent understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.
  • Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials.
  • Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.
  • Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems.

Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Additional Information

  • Seniority level: Not Applicable
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Finance and Sales
  • Industries: Research Services

Chair, LVHN Department of Psychiatry
Lehigh Valley Health Network (LVHN), proudly part of Jefferson Health, is seeking a proven and effective leader to spearhead our Department of Psychiatry as Chair. The Chair will support the Lehigh Valley Fleming Neuroscience Institute as part of the LVHN legacy services in addition to the Psychiatry & Human Behavior service line under Jefferson Health.

Position Overview
Chair, LVHN Department of Psychiatry
Lehigh Valley Health Network (LVHN), proudly part of Jefferson Health, is seeking a proven and effective leader to spearhead our Department of Psychiatry as Chair. The Chair will support the Lehigh Valley Fleming Neuroscience Institute as part of the LVHN legacy services in addition to the Psychiatry & Human Behavior service line under Jefferson Health.
The Department of Psychiatry at LVHN is one of four pillars of the Lehigh Valley Fleming Neuroscience Institute, the other pillars being the Department of Neurology, the Department of Neurosurgery, and the Fleming Memory Center. Under this Institute structure, these four key entities are devoted to the clinical, academic/research, and educational missions related to brain/nervous system and mental health in the region and beyond. The Lehigh Valley Fleming Neuroscience Institute is a system partner of the Vicky and Jack Farber Institute for Neuroscience of Thomas Jefferson University.
LVHN and our Department of Psychiatry are dedicated to providing a safe and comfortable place for our community to overcome life’s challenges. Our team of psychiatrists, psychologists, physician assistants, certified registered nurse practitioners, licensed clinical social workers, psychiatric nurses and occupational therapists work collaboratively to ensure the best outcomes for their patients.
In addition to our inpatient behavioral health services at Lehigh Valley Hospital (LVH)–Muhlenberg, LVH–Schuylkill and LVH–Pocono, we provide short-term services at LVH–Muhlenberg and LVH–Cedar Crest, which include individual, couples, family and group therapy. Our department also aids with medication management to children, adolescents and adults.

We provide a full continuum of care in behavioral health from emergency evaluation to intensive care, partial hospitalization, outpatient follow-up, homecare and skilled nursing facility consultation. We are growing the Department of Psychiatry which is comprised of more than 30 Psychiatrists and 120 mental health professionals in addition to our residency and fellowship programs.
Discover more about LVHN along with our mission and values on our about page or learn more about the LVHN Department of Psychiatry.

As Chair Of Psychiatry With LVHN, You Will
Oversee clinical operations of the Department of Psychiatry. Provide leadership and management oversight in areas of quality improvement, care management, clinical program development, business development, medical staff relationships and policies, education and research.

  • Essential functions include:
  • Appoint and supervise all Division Chiefs, the program director of the department's residency programs, and other physician leaders within the department.
  • Develop, implement and manage quality improvement and care management programs.
  • Oversee, manage and maintain the quality of all educational and research activities.
  • Appoint appropriate physician and non-physician leadership for the department's educational and research activities.
  • Work with other members of the administration on the development of clinical programs designed to meet the needs of the people served by the network.
  • Work collaboratively with the Network Office of Research and Innovation and LVHN’sInstitutional Review Board to ensure the research produced by department members meets the rigorous standards of human subject safety and academic excellence.
  • Oversee the business and financial implications of psychiatry program development.
  • Serve as a member of the Lehigh Valley Physician Group (LVPG) Board of Governors.
  • Serve as a member of the network’s Medical Executive Committee.
  • Maintain good relationships with network affiliated education organizations.
  • Collaborate with all clinical entity leaders to provide comprehensive psychiatric programs for our community.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Jefferson Health and within the Behavioral Health service line to provide comprehensive care across our community.
Compensation and benefits for Chair, Department of Psychiatry with LVHN
We acknowledge the dedication of our colleagues and offer a benefits package that makes LVHN an even better place to work and grow your career. And now that we’re proudly part of Jefferson Health, we can offer current and future clinicians new educational and development opportunities at Thomas Jefferson University across our larger service area. We leverage its position as a world-class medical institution to recruit the best and brightest clinicians.
Our compensation/rewards package is highly competitive, and benchmark driven, including a significant opportunity for a performance-based incentive. As a large health network, we also offer a robust and comprehensive benefits package including health, vision, dental, short / long term disability, CME and retirement benefits, to name a few.
About The Lehigh Valley Area
The Lehigh Valley is one of the fastest-growing areas in the country, located in the heart of eastern Pennsylvania, 60 miles from Philadelphia and 80 miles from New York City. The area has outstanding public and private school systems, more than a half-dozen colleges and universities and an abundance of cultural and recreational year-round offerings. As a resident of the Lehigh Valley, you’ll experience the charming, close-knit community atmosphere while being just a short drive from the hustle and bustle of larger cities. Learn more about the Lehigh Valley by visiting our careers page.

The Risk division is responsible for credit, market and operational risk, model risk, independent liquidity risk, and insurance throughout the firm.

Credit Risk (CR) is responsible for managing the firm’s credit exposure to its trading and lending counterparties. Join to apply for the MÉDICO NEUROLOGISTA - CER role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde .

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

title: Senior Product Manager – Warehouse OPS
description:
A Daki nasceu para revolucionar o delivery de mercado. O que antes alguém recebia em horas ou dias, agora recebe em minutos!
Mais que entregar rápido, buscamos entregar uma experiência incrível para os nossos clientes. Buscamos aquele "UAU" de quando o cliente recebe muito antes do que esperava.
E tudo começa muito antes da montagem do pedido, na verdade, começa bem aqui.
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Senior Product Manager para liderar a evolução dos produtos relacionados à gestão de armazéns (Warehouse OPS) que envolve toda a nossa operação de centros de distribuição e dark stores. Essa pessoa será responsável por conectar as necessidades do negócio com soluções escaláveis e eficientes, colaborando com áreas como Engenharia, Design, Dados e Operações.
Responsabilidades
Entender profundamente as necessidades do negócio relacionadas à operação e gestão de armazéns;
Definir a estratégia de evolução dos sistemas existentes, visando maximizar o impacto nos resultados do negócio;
Especificar requisitos de produto (PRDs) claros e orientados por valor;
Planejar e gerenciar o roadmap de produtos voltados à gestão de warehouse;
Liderar o planejamento e execução de sprints em parceria com times multifuncionais;
Atuar na gestão cross-functional junto aos times de Engenharia, Design, Dados e Operações;
Acompanhar testes de aceitação e garantir a qualidade das entregas;
Coordenar o deploy e o go-live das soluções junto ao time de operações.
Requisitos
Proficiência em português e inglês (oral e escrita) para atuar com times locais e internacionais;
Experiência sólida em gerenciamento de produtos digitais;
Vivência em discovery, priorização, definição e lançamento de soluções de produto;
Capacidade analítica e de tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, influência e gestão de stakeholders;
Experiência na coordenação de squads multifuncionais em ambientes ágeis e dinâmicos.
Informações adicionais:
Estamos em crescimento: Nosso modelo de trabalho é home office, permitindo que o Dakier atue de forma remota e presencial;
Somos Modernos: por meio de um cartão de crédito da bandeira Mastercard, você recebe o vale refeição, dando mais liberdade ao Dakier de como utilizar;
Transporte: realizamos o depósito direto no VT de acordo com a necessidade de passagem do Dakier até a unidade;
Saúde: Hoje disponibilizamos para o nosso Dakier a Assistência Médica e Odontológica, e também o Total Pass;
Mimo: Nossos Dakier tem desconto de 10% em todas as compras feitas em nosso do APP.

Sobre a Daki:
Poucas indústrias passaram por uma revolução tão grande na pandemia da COVID-19 como a do delivery de supermercado. Ao mesmo tempo que muitas empresas consolidadas cresceram ainda mais nesse período, elas ainda não conseguiam entregar uma boa experiência para seus clientes.
E nós sabíamos que o cliente merecia mais. Por isso, resolvemos desenvolver um modelo do zero, com foco total nas pessoas e com a ambição de uma startup que busca a liderança de mercado!
Aí criamos a Daki. :)
Somos o app de delivery mais rápido do Brasil. Entregamos mais de 1000 produtos na sua porta em minutos! Simples, intuitivo e super rápido - para você ter tempo de desfrutar o melhor da sua vida sem precisar perder tempo indo ao supermercado.
Nossos produtos foram cuidadosamente selecionados para atender aos prazeres do dia-a-dia e também às necessidades de uma vida agitada. Temos da cerveja gelada ao carregador de celular, e estamos sempre à procura de inovações que entreguem experiências ainda melhores para a nossa exigente clientela.
Estamos em busca de pessoas que compartilhem essa visão de um mundo mais simples, tecnológico e com foco no cliente, e também que transbordem energia para tirar esse sonho do papel. Se você se identificou, esse é um bom sinal!

Nossos valores:
Na Daki, acreditamos que é possível revolucionar o mercado sem abrir mão do que é mais importante: as pessoas.
Cuidar de você e do outro é essencial para manter um ambiente de trabalho leve, onde todos se sintam seguros, física e psicologicamente.
Colaborar é a chave para o sucesso. Estamos sempre atentos às necessidades e objetivos de todos, porque sabemos que o nosso propósito final é comum: encantar nossos clientes!
Entregar do Jeito Certo significa agir com integridade e ética, enfrentando desafios de frente para garantir a melhor qualidade, experiência e valor em tudo o que fazemos.
Mas não queremos apenas atender expectativas, queremos Surpreender. Ir além do esperado e fazer tudo parecer mágica faz parte do nosso DNA.
Inovar está no nosso dia a dia. Para isso, estamos sempre dispostos a Questionar. Se existe uma forma melhor e mais eficiente, nós vamos atrás dela. Sempre com base em dados e com uma abordagem estruturada para propor mudanças que façam a diferença.
E, claro, também precisamos Curtir o caminho. Celebramos cada conquista – das pequenas até as grandes – com brilho nos olhos, aprendendo com os erros e criando espaço para aquilo que mais importa na vida.
Se você se identifica com essa forma de trabalhar e viver, então você encontrou o seu lugar.
Seja bem-vinda(o) à nossa página de Carreiras!

We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.

  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other

  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

- Feito por pessoas, com alma e coração: o toque humano está em tudo que fazemos.

You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.
As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan, have no offices and therefore no pressure to work from an office.
The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners
What we are looking for in you
  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers

We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey.

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. title: Pleegzorgbegeleider Haaglanden
description:
Ben jij er graag voor pleegkinderen, ouder(s) en pleegouders, zodat kinderen kunnen opgroeien in een stabiele en fijne omgeving? Kom dan werken als pleegzorgbegeleider bij Timon in de regio Haaglanden.

Doortastend, geduldig en daadkrachtig

Een stabiele en veilige omgeving is niet altijd vanzelfsprekend. Daar weten we bij Timon alles van. Lukt het echt niet thuis, dan is een pleeggezin vaak een oplossing, voor korte of langere tijd. We proberen altijd om een kind terug te laten gaan naar de ouders, tenzij het niet anders kan. Als pleegzorgbegeleider bij Timon ondersteun je ouder(s), pleegouders en pleegkinderen bij de uitdagingen waarvoor zij staan. Elke situatie is anders. En het kan gaan om een vrijwillige plaatsing, voogdij of een ondertoezichtstelling (OTS). Dat vraagt van jou als pleegzorgbegeleider om geduld, sensitiviteit en daadkracht. Je kunt goed organiseren en houdt overzicht. En, als de situatie erom vraagt, overwicht.

Jouw werk doet ertoe

Als pleegzorgbegeleider coördineer je de pleegzorgplaatsing en alles wat daarbij komt kijken. Je begeleidt de samenwerking tussen ouder(s) en pleegouders. Daarbij staat het belang en de ontwikkeling van het kind altijd voorop. Je ondersteunt richting kind, pleegouders en ouder(s) in hun rol. Je monitort de samenwerking en signaleert. En biedt individuele ondersteuning en gezamenlijk ondersteuning in de samenwerking in het zorgteam. Samen zoek je naar oplossingen. Je signaleert spanningen en emoties. Hebt oog voor loyaliteit en hechting. En kijkt altijd naar het beste voor het kind. Met als doel: een fijne omgeving zodat het kind zich kan ontwikkelen. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe.

Dit ga je doen

  • Je ondersteunt het kind, de pleegouders en de ouders en bent de schakel tussen hen.
  • Je stelt samen doelen op, legt die vast in een plan en gaat daarmee aan de slag.
  • Je bent een klankbord voor pleegouders en biedt handvatten voor zorg en opvoeding.
  • Je houdt contact met instanties als zoals school, GGZ, Jeugdbescherming en CJG.
  • Je zorgt dat iedereen zich gehoord en gezien voelt
  • Je werkt zelfstandig en overlegt met collega’s en de gedragswetenschapper .

'Het mooist vind ik wanneer we samen met ouders en pleegouders een kind zien ontwikkelen.'

Nicole van Schaijk, pleegzorgbegeleider bij Timon. Lees het heleverhaal van Nicole .

Dit vragen we van je

  • Een relevant hbo-diploma (bijvoorbeeld Social Work of Pedagogiek).
  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie.
  • Rijbewijs B en een auto.
  • Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden.
  • Een aantal jaar relevante werkervaring in de jeugd- of pleegzorg.

Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maand salaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg (schaal 9) van € 3. 191,69 tot € 4.929,28, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
  • Een jaarcontract van 24 uur tot 36 uur per week. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dit contract om in een vast dienstverband.
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris.
  • Een eigen coach die jou helpt met je persoonlijke doelstellingen en ontwikkeling.

Binnen Timon krijg je een uitgebreid inwerktraject waarin we je koppelen aan een buddy. Daarnaast volg je diverse trainingen en opleidingen gericht op jouw functie, zoals: Functiescholing pleegzorg, Contextuele hulpverlening en Traumasensitief werken.

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Jij @ Timon?

Herken je jezelf in deze vacature en denk je dat je past bij onze organisatie? Solliciteer dan snel, de collega’s van Haaglanden gaan graag met je in gesprek.

title: Gedragswetenschapper alleenstaande moeders en kind
description:
Als gedragswetenschapper werk je op alle niveaus mee aan goede zorg en ondersteuning aan jongeren en jongvolwassenen en hun gezin. Met jouw skills help je collega’s hun cliënten goed te begeleiden en samen de kwaliteit van maatschappelijke zorg te waarborgen. Voor het team van Noa in Amsterdam zijn we op zoek naar een gedragswetenschapper voor 16 uur per week.

Noa biedt 24-uurs ondersteuning aan (jonge) moeders tussen de 18 en 40 jaar zonder vaste woon- of verblijfplaats. In een kleinschalige woonomgeving worden moeder en kind opgevangen en begeleid richting zelfstandigheid. Deze begeleiding wordt uitgevoerd door maatschappelijk begeleiders, ondersteund door pedagogisch medewerkers. Daarnaast zijn er ouder-kind begeleiders gekoppeld aan de locatie, die zich specifiek bezighouden met het bevorderen van de ouder-kind interactie. In de voorziening wonen tevens omwoners die als goede buur voor de cliënten aanwezig zijn.

Analytisch, inspirerend, daadkrachtig

Als gedragswetenschapper geef jij, samen met de teammanager, duaal sturing aan het team van maatschappelijk begeleiders en pedagogisch medewerkers. Hulpverleners hebben de juiste vaardigheden en tools nodig om hun cliënten goed te begeleiden. Jij coacht hen daarbij en bespreekt de kwaliteit van zorg in de werkbegeleidingsgesprekken. Je sluit aan bij de vragen van hulpverleners en denkt mee over casuïstiek. Je traint hen met jouw kennis en ervaring. Je volgt de ontwikkelingen in de wetenschap en in de samenleving. Samen met de afdeling Strategie & Beleid werk je aan doorontwikkeling van zorgconcepten. En in samenwerking met de regiomanager bewaak je de kwaliteit van zorg én de zichtbaarheid van het zorgaanbod bij gemeenten en collega-organisaties. Dat vraagt wat van je. Je bent analytisch, inspirerend en onderzoekend. In acute situaties treed je daadkrachtig op.

Jouw werk doet ertoe!

Als gedragswetenschapper ben je er vooral voor de zorgprofessionals. Samen met de hulpverleners zet je begeleidings- en behandeltrajecten op en houd je deze op de rit. Je werkt veelal alleen in deze functie, mét de mogelijkheid om te sparren met andere gedragswetenschappers in Amsterdam of het land. Bijvoorbeeld als je ergens tegenaan loopt in jouw zorgconcept. De protocollen en richtlijnen maken we op maat voor de specifieke situatie van cliënten. Het mooie is dat je ook invloed hebt op de kwaliteit van zorg in het algemeen. Jouw werk doet ertoe! Wil je meer zien over het werk van onze Gedragswetenschappers, bekijk dan hier het filmpje van Helga , één van onze Gedragswetenschappers binnen Timon.

Dit ga je doen

  • Je stuurt met de teammanager het team duaal aan.
  • Je werkt samen met ketenpartners rondom een cliënt, zoals bv GGD.
  • Je ondersteunt de regiomanager en spart over ontwikkelingen in de jeugdzorg.
  • Je maakt kwartaalrapportages en analyseert de uitkomsten inhoudelijk.
  • Je hebt contacten met cliënten, onder meer bij het begeleiden van groepsprocessen.
  • Je bent betrokken bij het nemen van kernbeslissingen.
  • Je biedt nabijheid en coaching on the job aan het team.

“Als gedragswetenschapper ben je betrokken bij het beleid en bij de uitvoering daarvan door begeleiders. Dat maakt dit werk veelzijdig en waardevol”

Susanne, gedragswetenschapper

Dit vragen we van je

Deze functie noemen we in ons functiehuis: gedragswetenschapper. Je bent analytisch sterk, sociaal en slagvaardig. Daarnaast kun je goed werken op individuele basis. Verder beschik je over:

  • Een universitair masterdiploma richting gedragswetenschappen, zoals psychologie of orthopedagogiek.
  • Kennis van gedragsproblematiek en -stoornissen en ervaring met erkende therapeutische (crisis)interventies en behandelmethoden.
  • Ervaring met het coachen en aansturen van teams en/of hulpverleners.
  • Je hebt een hands-on mentaliteit.
  • Kennis van de wet- en regelgeving.

Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao jeugdzorg (schaal 11) van € 3.834,03 tot € 5.793,72, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
  • Jaarcontract voor 16 uur per week. Bevalt het wederzijds? Dan zetten we dit om in een vast dienstverband.
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris.

Het is ook mogelijk om in combinatie met de vacature Gedragswetenschapper jonge moeders en kind , 32 uur per week werken.

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Jij @ Timon?

Denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij jou past? Solliciteer dan op de vacature voor gedragswetenschapper. Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiter.

title: Gedragswetenschapper Rotterdam
description:
Als gedragswetenschapper werk je op alle niveaus mee aan goede zorg en ondersteuning aan jongeren en jongvolwassenen en hun gezin. Met jouw skills help je collega’s hun cliënten goed te begeleiden en samen de kwaliteit van maatschappelijke zorg te waarborgen. Voor het team van Noa in Rotterdam zijn we op zoek naar een gedragswetenschapper voor 20-24 uur per week.

Op Noa bieden onze hulpverleners ondersteuning aan (jong-)volwassen vrouwen tussen 18-25 jaar, deels moeder met kind, met meervoudige problematiek. Als gedragswetenschapper versterk en begeleid je de hulpverleners. Je denkt overstijgend en legt verbanden die anderen niet snel zien. Jij begrijpt het belang van samenwerking binnen en buiten de organisatie. De hulpverleners binnen jouw team komen graag bij jou voor advies over complexe casussen. Meer weten over de functie van gedragswetenschapper zie ook onze video .

Analytisch, inspirerend, daadkrachtig

Hulpverleners hebben de juiste vaardigheden en tools nodig om hun cliënten goed te begeleiden. Als gedragswetenschapper coach jij hen daarin. Je sluit aan bij de vragen van hulpverleners. Denkt mee over casuïstiek. En traint hen met jouw kennis en ervaring. Je volgt de ontwikkelingen in de wetenschap en in de samenleving. En in samenwerking met de teammanager bewaak je de kwaliteit van zorg én de zichtbaarheid van het zorgaanbod bij gemeenten en collega-organisaties. Dat vraagt wat van je. Je bent analytisch, inspirerend en onderzoekend. In acute situaties treed je daadkrachtig op.

Jouw werk doet ertoe!

Als gedragswetenschapper ben je er vooral voor de zorgprofessionals. Samen met de hulpverleners zet je begeleidings- en behandeltrajecten op en houd je deze op de rit. Je werkt veelal alleen in deze functie, mét de mogelijkheid om te sparren met andere gedragswetenschappers. Bijvoorbeeld als je ergens tegenaan loopt in jouw zorgconcept. De protocollen en richtlijnen maken we op maat voor de specifieke situatie van cliënten. Het mooie is dat je ook invloed hebt op de kwaliteit van zorg in het algemeen. Jouw werk doet ertoe!

Dit ga je doen

  • Je werkt samen met ketenpartners rondom een cliënt, zoals de jeugdteams en Jeugdbescherming
  • Je trekt samen met de teammanager op en spart over ontwikkelingen in de jeugdzorg
  • Je maakt kwartaalrapportages en analyseert de uitkomsten inhoudelijk
  • Je bent betrokken bij het nemen van kernbeslissingen

“Als gedragswetenschapper ben je betrokken bij het beleid en bij de uitvoering daarvan door begeleiders. Dat maakt dit werk veelzijdig en waardevol”

Susanne Kooij, gedragswetenschapper jeugdzorg

Dit vragen we van je

Je bent analytisch sterk, sociaal en slagvaardig. Daarnaast kun je goed werken op individuele basis. Verder beschik je over:

  • Een universitair masterdiploma richting gedragswetenschappen, zoals psychologie of orthopedagogiek
  • Kennis van gedragsproblematiek en -stoornissen en ervaring met erkende therapeutische (crisis)interventies en behandelmethoden
  • Ervaring met het coachen van hulpverleners
  • Kennis van de wet- en regelgeving

Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao jeugdzorg (schaal 11) van € 3.972,06 tot € 6.002,30, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring
  • Jaarcontract. Bevalt het wederzijds? Dan zetten we dit om in een vast dienstverband
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding
  • Eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris
  • Trainingen en opleiding gericht op jouw functie

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 750 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Jij @ Timon?

Herken je jezelf in deze vacature en denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij jou past? Solliciteer dan snel; we gaan graag met je in gesprek. Voor vragen over de inhoud van de functie kan je contact opnemen met Ruud Bouman, regiomanager op 06-15233557.

Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiter.

Voor indiensttreding is het screeningsbeleid van Timon van toepassing. Deze is altijd opvraagbaar en wordt toegelicht in het arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek.

Job description

AQUI SUA CARREIRA COMEÇA GRANDE.

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA COORDENADOR CURSO I NA ESTÁCIO.

Temos um projeto grandioso que requer um time com disposição para pensar de forma original e disruptiva, com o objetivo de resolver as grandes questões de hoje na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários.

Venha fazer parte desse time!

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.


Main responsibilities

Os principais desafios como PESSOA COORDENADOR CURSO I são:

  • Ajudar os nossos alunos em suas metas, por meio de uma boa relação, fazendo-os perceber que devem procurá-lo sempre que for preciso para resolver problemas referentes ao seu dia a dia na faculdade, como escolha de disciplinas, problemas ou queixas com os docentes, ou demais pedidos e demandas que venham a surgir, colaborando para que nossos alunos possam atingir seus objetivos educacionais e de carreira;
  • Trabalhar em equipe com os professores, com empenho e foco, visando a uma contínua melhora no processo de ensino, proporcionando toda a orientação necessária para que possam cumprir as metas e os prazos acadêmicos;
  • Atuar como agente principal de efetivação da proposta pedagógica de nossas Instituições de Ensino;
  • Cumprir os prazos estabelecidos no calendário acadêmico;
  • Contribuir para a realização de ações preparatórias para o ENADE;
  • Registrar, por meio do sistema de informações acadêmicas (SIA), os resultados das atividades acadêmicas dos alunos;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos prazos dos processos acadêmicos;
  • Trabalhar em equipe com os órgãos de assessoramento para elaborar ou atualizar o Projeto Pedagógico do Curso;
  • Receber as comissões do MEC para o processo de autorização, reconhecimento e renovações;
  • Realizar atividades acadêmicas complementares para os alunos.

Requirements and skills

Buscamos profissionais com:

  • Titulação Mínima: MESTRE;
  • Formação Superior em GRADUAÇÃO EM ENGENHARIA E/OU ÁREAS CORRELATAS;
  • Desejável experiência como docente e em cargo de gestão;
  • Capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento com o aluno;
  • Atualização e domínio de conhecimentos teóricos e práticos para a função pretendida.

Additional information

Local de Trabalho: Estácio Fortaleza Centro.

Horário de Jornada: 20h semanais.

Na ESTÁCIO você vai encontrar:

  • Bolsas de estudo de até 100% para colaboradores, dependentes legais e agregados;
  • Assistência médica com subsídio integral para o colaborador e parcial para sua família;
  • Assistência odontológica opcional;
  • Vale Refeição com opção de escolha;
  • Gympass para opções flexíveis de academias;
  • Bem-estar e clube de vantagens com programa dedicado;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Universidade Corporativa no nosso portal exclusivo;
  • Oportunidades de crescimento , hoje mais de 60% das vagas são fechadas com processo de seleção interno.

Modelo de trabalho híbrido para todos os escritórios corporativos da companhia.

Trabalho remoto (home office) estendido para os pais recém-chegados da licença maternidade e paternidade por até 3 meses.

Acreditamos na excelência do nosso ensino e, por isso, valorizamos os egressos das nossas instituições em nossos processos seletivos.

Mais inclusão: essa vaga também é destinada a pessoas com deficiência.

DIVERSIDADE: A YDUQS valoriza a diversidade e as informações adicionais prestadas nos campos de diversidade são muito importantes para nós.

Descrição de atividades:

Instalar bandejas para dreno de ar-condicionado;

Desentupir dreno de ar-condicionado;

Executar outras tarefas correlatas, quando necessário;

Instalar aparelhos de ar-condicionado de janela e split;

Realizar atendimento imediato das solicitações de serviços, de acordo com a competência do cargo, para manutenção em todos os setores do Hospital, tomando as medidas de precaução com o uso dos EPI's corretos nos locais e tarefas que assim o exigirem;

Realizar manutenção das câmaras frigoríficas, substituindo peças, lubrificando, montando e desmontando os compressores, e verificando a parte elétrica.

Realizar manutenção em geladeiras, freezers, balcões frigoríficos e frigobares.

Realizar manutenções corretivas nos Chiller's, nas centrais de ar-condicionado, fan-coils, Fan coletes, cortinas de ar, CELF, aparelhos de ar condicionado de janela e split, periodicamente, mantendo atualizado relatório sobre os equipamentos;

Realizar montagem e desmontagem dos aparelhos de ar-condicionado de janela e split, efetuando troca de rolamento do motor, revisão nas partes elétricas, limpeza geral, etc.

Realizar o preenchimento dos chamados dentro do Sistema GLPI com informações de tarefas até a sua conclusão, para dar retorno ao requerente sobre o andamento dos serviços;

Trocar informações junto a Supervisão quanto aos serviços executados, sobre o andamento e conclusão dele, e solicitando compra de materiais quando necessário;

Zelar pela manutenção, limpeza e conservação de todo material e equipamento sob sua responsabilidade;

Realizar movimentação de bens patrimoniais, de acordo com a solicitação do setor de patrimônio e orientações da supervisão;

Instalar tubulações de gases medicinais (oxigênio, ar comprimido, oxido nitroso e vácuo) que alimentam todo o Hospital.;

Realizar manutenção nas tubulações e postos de gases medicinais de oxigênio, ar comprimido, vácuo e oxido nitroso, realizando a troca de válvulas e mangueiras em caso de vazamento, em todos os setores que dispõem;

Realizar manutenção corretiva nos postos de vácuo da UTI, Centro Cirúrgico, Endoscopia e demais setores que possuem, de acordo com abertura dos chamados no sistema realizado pelos setores, conforme demanda. Realizando a troca das válvulas e desentupimento da rede.

Realizar manutenção preventiva nos postos de vácuo da UTI, Centro Cirúrgico, Endoscopia e demais setores que possuem, conforme cronograma anual, realizando o desentupimento da rede e troca de válvulas que estejam danificadas;

Realizar manutenção preventiva mensal dos equipamentos e centrais de ar-condicionado, conforme atividades descritas na periodicidade do relatório do PMOC, realizando limpeza de filtros, troca de filtro HEPA das centrais, lavando os aparelhos, realizando medições elétricas, vistoria nos motores e outros. Manter o corretor preenchimento dos relatórios do PMOC e fechamento das ordens de serviços no sistema.

Convênio médico e odontológico (PARTICIPATIVO);

Vale transporte;

Alimentação na empresa por R$0,50 dia (Café da manhã e Almoço);

Convênio com faculdades;

Gympass.

Nossa história

Nossa história nasceu do sonho de uma grande mulher empreendedora, a espanhola Asunción Romacho. Em 1960, dona "Asun", como era chamada carinhosamente, chegou ao Brasil. Trouxe junto no navio os três filhos, a sogra e a experiência de sete anos como dona de uma ferragem na cidade espanhola de Guadix, na Andaluzia.

No ano de 1963, seu marido Ernesto instalou um pequeno armazém que ficava junto à casa da família, no bairro Cavalhada, onde todos trabalharam juntos durante anos.

Em 1975, a família deixou Porto Alegre rumo a Quintão, com muitos desafios, pois naquela época não havia luz elétrica na cidade. A iluminação ficava por conta de lampiões, carne, manteiga e perecíveis eram mantidos em isopores. Não tinha horário, "Eu começava às vezes às 7h e só saía meia-noite. Ficava até quando tinha cliente" – lembra a matriarca, em bom espanhol, que os mais de 40 anos no Brasil não a fizeram perder. Asunción passou 10 anos em Quintão, até voltar para Porto Alegre, em 1985. No retorno à Capital, a fundadora não abriu mão de seu lugar, de pé, atrás de uma caixa da loja.

A rede cresceu e a matriarca de uma família supermercadista tem hoje seu apelido estampado na fachada de 42 lojas, agora presentes não só em praias gaúchas mas também em Porto Alegre, Região Metropolitana de Porto Alegre e Serra Gaúcha.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.
The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open-source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.
Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.
As an Engineering Manager, your primary responsibility is to the people you lead and support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and finding satisfaction in their career at Canonical. We need someone who can display technical leadership by leveraging a solid background in software development so that they're able to challenge and grow their team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on direction and execution.
What you will do

  • Lead and develop a team of Python engineers working remotely in global locations
  • Hiring, coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing code yourself
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering and operations teams
  • Coordinate with management and internal and external stakeholders or customers
  • Advocate for modern, agile software development practices
  • Help develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Travel globally up to 10% of time for internal and external events
Who you are
  • You love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about agile software development
  • You love leading, coaching, and mentoring software developers - especially Python ones
  • You are knowledgeable in cloud computing concepts & technologies
  • You are comfortable administrating Linux servers, including their storage and networking
  • You have hands-on experience with software automation
  • You are organized and want your team to deliver high-quality software in a timely manner
  • You are a lifelong learner
Bonus points for
  • You have graduated with a university degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field
  • Having a thorough understanding of modern infrastructure, including OpenStack or Kubernetes
  • Having experience in operations as well as software development
  • Being familiar with the challenges of large-scale, multi-cloud operations
  • Go expertise
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

You will be the primary point of contact for client and internal escalations, ensuring smooth and efficient operations while fostering strong, long-lasting relationships.
