description:
Description

Willis Towers Watson (WTW) is seeking ambitious, analytical underwriting talent with 5-10 years of experience in the insurance industry with experience in builders’ risk and property underwriting. This is a high-profile client facing role working directly with WTW CRB NA to develop new and existing partnerships in line with its strategic growth initiatives. The successful candidate will work in a highly collaborative Verita (MGU) team environment.

Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.

The Role

  • Work with WTW’s broking team(s), Verita executives, actuaries, and cat modelers to analyze Verita’s insurance risks on a portfolio level to obtain capacity in the form of delegated authority, reinsurance structures and/or other innovative solutions.
  • Negotiate and place Reinsurance Treaties and/or FAC placements utilizing markets from London, the US, Bermuda and around the world.
  • Coordinate and attend underwriting and claim audits with Verita’s capacity markets on a regular basis.
  • Ensure that company, market and client related documentation is issued (internally and externally) accurately and on time.
  • Comply with external regulatory and internal statutory policies, procedures and regulations.
  • Coordinate internal resources, such as analytics, contracts and client services to provide solutions to client(s).
  • Meet with senior management both internally and externally to present materials.
  • The candidate must have experience in Builder’s Risk, General Liability and Property
    • Candidates with significant experience/relationships in one of these areas will be considered and expected to develop the expertise in the other areas.
  • Conduct comprehensive market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks to Verita’s portfolio.
  • Engage with capacity providers and reinsurance markets to negotiate terms, pricing, and coverage to secure optimal outcomes for Verita.
  • Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory changes, and emerging risks that may impact reinsurance strategies.
  • Assist in the training and development of graduate hires.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
  • Good understanding of pricing components and rating methodologies
  • Uses all appropriate underwriting tools, disciplines and knowledge of strategies to ensure underwriting guidelines are followed
  • Exhibits strong underwriting skills through strategic, thorough account reviews and file documentation
  • Adheres to guidelines and underwriting discipline to minimize exposure and appropriately price risk.
  • Complete understanding and ability to use sophisticated pricing models across various structures, guaranteed cost, captives, SIR’s, deductibles, etc.

Qualifications

The Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from a four-year College or university.
  • 8+ years of work experience, preferably in Property and Casualty insurance, reinsurance or related non-life insurance consulting.
  • Understanding of Managing General Underwriter program life cycles and placements.
  • Strong negotiation skills
  • Ability to multi-task priorities in a fast-paced, high intensity environment.
  • Experience in giving presentations to prospects, capacity partners and internal groups.
  • Computer skills, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook.
  • Effective analysis, problem solving and communication skills.
  • Strong knowledge of property insurance policies and regulations.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in assessments.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Very strong technical and leadership qualities
  • Well established in the marketplace and has excellent relationships with brokers and agents on both regional and national level
  • Well versed and experienced in working, producing and underwriting all sizes of accounts with large brokerage houses, agents and specialty retailers.
  • Established underwriting, quoting and binding track record of profitable business.

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until a sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

Compensation and Benefits
Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).

Compensation
The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $150,000 - $250,000 USD per year. This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.
Company Benefits
WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes paid state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave),Paid Time Off
  • Retirement Benefits: Contributory Pension Plan and Savings Plan (401k). All Level 38 and more senior roles may also be eligible for non-qualified Deferred Compensation and Deferred Savings Plans.

At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools and environment you need to be successful. The majority of our colleagues work in a ”hybrid” style, with a mix of remote, in-person and in-office interactions dependent on the needs of the team, role and clients. Our flexibility is rooted in trust and “hybrid” is not a one-size-fits-all solution.

We understand flexibility is key to supporting an inclusive and diverse workforce and so we encourage requests for all types of flexible working as well as location-based arrangements. Please speak to your recruiter to discuss more.

title: Director, Ecosystem Engineering
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

Join us in shaping the future of Fortnite — one of the world’s most influential interactive platforms. We’re looking for an experienced engineering leader to drive the development of foundational systems that support the Fortnite experience at scale — including player onboarding, progression, identity, lobbies, and purchasing. These systems form the connective tissue of the Fortnite ecosystem, powering player interaction, progression, and seamless transitions between experiences. This role is central to our goal of delivering consistent, high-quality user experiences across internal and third-party content — while enabling scale, flexibility, and innovation for the entire platform.

In this role, you will

  • Set the technical vision and architecture for Fortnite’s ecosystem systems, driving scalability, consistency, and platform evolution.
  • Lead development of features that span all Fortnite content, ensuring unified experiences and reliable scale across modes
  • Partner with internal teams (e.g., Battle Royale, LEGO Fortnite, new IPs) to ensure systems align with desired flows and player-facing requirements.
  • Collaborate with third-party developers to enable flexible, performant integration with Fortnite's shared systems.
  • Grow and lead a high-performing team, fostering a culture of innovation, inclusion, and engineering excellence.
  • Drive platform evolution while balancing stability, performance, and flexibility for diverse use cases.
  • Drive innovation and creative problem solving in areas that do not have an internal precedent

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience architecting and building user-facing systems in a live services or platform environment (e.g., menus, accounts, progression, commerce).
  • Strong understanding of scalable backend and client-service patterns, ideally in cross-platform or online service contexts.
  • Comfortable navigating complex user flows and dependencies across multiple teams and surfaces.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills with a track record of cross-functional collaboration.
  • Passion for building intuitive, reliable systems that support a wide range of player and developer needs.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional recent graduate as junior Legal Advisor or junior Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical they will have the opportunity to work on a variety of transactional matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as the contracts that underpin global employment, contracting and partnerships. In this appointment we are more focused on ability than experience; the position is open to applicants with a relevant degree, but does not have a requirement for extensive work experience. The successful candidate will work closely with our in-house legal team and colleagues worldwide.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate good commercial judgment as well as being organized, efficient, and capable to provide high quality legal and commercial advice. We are looking for a rigorous work ethic, detailed analysis, conscientiousness, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement.
Location : This role is home based in Europe, the Middle East, Africa or the Americas, with the option of our London office.
The role entails

  • Report to our global general counsel
  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and vendors in many countries across the globe
  • Provide legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical's sales organization
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to support company initiatives
  • Utilize Canonical's contract management system to ensure accurate data is maintained for signed contracts
  • Work with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active license to practice law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-cultural environment
  • Effective both independently and as part of a team
  • A passion for technology evidenced by personal initiatives and projects
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience in commercial transactions, intellectual property, or corporate law
  • Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices
  • Understanding of the open source software community and values
  • Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software
  • Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart, and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses, and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Regional Product Director, Threat Intelligence Solutions – LAC (RF #177)

About us
At Mastercard, we are committed to safeguarding the digital ecosystem by pioneering cutting-edge security solutions. As cyber threats evolve, so do we—leveraging deep expertise in network security and data intelligence to protect transactions worldwide. We don’t just react to cyber threats; we stay ahead of them.

As a key member of the Security Solutions Organization (SSO), you’ll be at the forefront of this mission, ensuring our Threat Intelligence solutions empower businesses across Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) to mitigate risks and build resilience in an increasingly complex cybersecurity landscape.

Your role

As Regional Product Director, Threat Intelligence Solutions, you will be the primary advocate for our intelligence-driven security products across LAC. You’ll lead go-to-market strategies, revenue growth, and product adoption while collaborating with internal teams and external stakeholders to drive innovation. Your expertise will shape how financial institutions and businesses across the region combat cyber threats.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Lead Regional Strategy & Execution—Manage the Threat Intelligence solutions market performance across LAC, overseeing revenue performance, defining KPIs, growth plans, and expansion strategies to develop a sustainable business model.
  2. Drive Revenue and Product Adoption—Oversee sales performance, support and maintain a strong customer pipeline, identify new opportunities, and develop business cases to scale our offerings.
  3. Product Roadmap & Market Insights—Collaborate with global teams to refine and localize solutions based on customer feedback and regional and local needs.
  4. Customer Engagement & Advocacy—Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring seamless onboarding, training, and continuous value delivery.
  5. Cyber Threat Intelligence Thought Leadership—Stay ahead of emerging threats and market trends, shaping how Mastercard delivers security across the payment and financial sectors.

What We’re Looking For

  1. Threat Intelligence Expertise—Deep understanding of cyber risk management, information security, and threat intelligence solutions.
  2. Payments & Financial Sector Experience—Strong industry knowledge and experience with financial institutions, payment networks, or fintechs.
  3. Proven Product Leadership—Background in product management, go-to-market strategy, and customer-driven innovation.
  4. Strategic & Analytical Mindset—Strong business case development, financial acumen, and ability to translate data into insights.
  5. Strong Communicator & Collaborator—Ability to work cross-functionally, influence stakeholders, and drive impact in a fast-moving environment.
  6. Multilingual Proficiency—Fluency in English (Spanish is highly recommended).

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks come with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Job Title:

Sr. Representative, Accounts Payable

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

The Associate, Accounts Payable, is responsible for invoice processing and payments of Telecom Facility at a global level. Perform accounts reconciliation, troubleshooting and Analyze discrepancies. Trace transactions, Validation of the vendors' invoices, verify of internal codes etc.

What you will do in this role

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.

The Following tasks may be performed with an emphasis on General accounting, accounts payable.

  • Examine, code, verify, reconciliation of various kind of transactions, listings vouchers, invoices, and reports.
  • Assign prescribed accounting distribution codes, Post registers or subsidiary ledgers.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting modules, concepts, and analysis of accounting sheets
  • Preparing, adjusting, and closing journal entries, analyse and verify internal consistency, completeness, and mathematical accuracy of accounts documents.
  • Maintain aspects of SAGE, Workday financial module, proficiency of MS Office application such as MS Excel and word.

Your qualifications

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Concentrix is a great match if you:

  • Bachelor’s degree in commerce (B.Com) or Business Administration (BBA), or equivalent qualification.
  • At least 1 year of experience in accountancy roles, with a focus on Accounts Payable (AP).
  • Well versed with the accounting concepts of AP/AR and reconciliation.
  • Advanced skills in MS Office applications, particularly MS Excel and Word.
  • Languages required (both are mandatory on the stated level): Portuguese C2 (bilingual/native) & English B2 or above (very good/fluent)

It will be a plus if you:

  • Experience with SAGE and Workday financial modules.

What’s in it for you

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW.

In this role, we offer benefits that help support your unique lifestyle:

  • Full-time indefinite contracts
  • Competitive salary and performance bonus
  • Bring-a-friend (referral) bonus opportunities
  • Full paid training on the company and the project you'll be working on
  • Career development programs, specialized courses, and language classes

Power the best version of you!

At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.

If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”

Concentrix is an equal opportunity employer

We're proudly united as one team, one company, globally. We're committed to equal employment opportunities for all candidates and a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. All our recruitment practices are based on business needs, job requirements, and professional qualifications, without regard to race, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, family or parental status, national origin, disability, or any other classification protected by applicable national laws.

title: Gestor de Tráfego
description:
Join to apply for the Gestor de Tráfego role at Tetra Educação

A Tetra Educação, uma referência em habilidades corporativas no Brasil, está em busca de um Gestor de Tráfego Sênior para se juntar ao nosso time. Atuamos no mercado digital, oferecendo cursos inovadores e atualizados que capacitam profissionais para alcançar alta performance no mercado de trabalho.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Gerenciar campanhas de tráfego pago em plataformas como Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads, TikTok Ads e outras redes estratégicas para a Tetra Educação.
  2. Estruturar, testar e otimizar campanhas com foco em conversão, garantindo custo por lead (CPL) e retorno sobre investimento (ROI) alinhados às metas da empresa.
  3. Desenvolver e executar estratégias de aquisição de tráfego para lançamentos e funis perpétuos.
  4. Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de copy e design para garantir a coerência e o desempenho dos criativos utilizados nas campanhas.
  5. Acompanhar e analisar análises de desempenho, identificando oportunidades de otimização para melhorar o desempenho das campanhas.
  6. Realizar testes A/B para anúncios, páginas de destino e segmentações de público.
  7. Criar estratégias de remarketing e segmentação avançadas para maximizar a participação e o engajamento do público.
  8. Monitorar tendências e atualizações das plataformas de mídia paga, aplicando as melhores práticas no tráfego digital.
  9. Elaborar relatórios de desempenho e apresentar insights estratégicos para tomadas de decisão.

Requisitos:

  1. Experiência comprovada na gestão de tráfego pago para negócios digitais, preferencialmente no setor educacional.
  2. Domínio das principais plataformas de anúncios, como Meta Ads, Google Ads e YouTube Ads.
  3. Conhecimento avançado de estratégias de segmentação, remarketing e otimização de campanhas.
  4. Capacidade analítica para interpretar métricas e ajustar campanhas com base em dados.
  5. Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e alinhar estratégias com as áreas de copy e criação.

  • Habilidade em extrair e estruturar bases de dados, além de proficiência em Excel
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão, tomar decisões baseadas em dados e ter visão estratégica do negócio.

title: Gerência de Global Sourcing
description:
- SOBRE A OPORTUNIDADE

Buscamos profissional para atuar com a estruturação da área de global sourcing da empresa. Será responsável por liderar e gerenciar o desenvolvimento de produtos com foco no sourcing global de matérias-primas e produtos acabados, assegurando o desenvolvimento de fornecedores estratégicos, preservando os critérios de qualidade estabelecidos para cada marca, definindo inclusive parâmetros técnicos de especificação dos produtos a serem desenvolvidos e a gestão eficiente da cadeia de fornecimento internacional e nacional. Deve garantir alinhamento com as estratégias corporativas e otimização de custos, qualidade e inovação.

Dentre as atividades, estão:

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de sourcing global, criando e gerenciando estratégias eficazes para a terceirização de processos e serviços;
  • Estabelecer e manter relacionamentos sólidos com fornecedores globais, garantindo que eles atendam os parâmetros de qualidade e desempenho;
  • Gerenciar desenvolvimento de produto com foco no sourcing global de matérias-primas e produtos acabados, assegurando custo-benefício, inovação e tendências de mercado;
  • Ajustar estratégias de fornecimento com base nas necessidades definidas pelas equipes de design e produtos e em previsões de demanda, garantindo equilíbrio entre ganhos de margem, qualidade e especificações técnicas de produto;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de produtos, desde briefing e fichas técnicas até aprovação de amostras e controle de qualidade junto aos fornecedores;
  • Verificar o desempenho dos fornecedores, solucionando problemas como qualidade, atendimento aos requisitos técnicos e desempenho de entrega em conjunto com a área de suprimentos;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de Marketing, Produto e Comercial, auxiliando na criação de estratégias e percepção de novas tendências do mercado;
  • Estruturar o time de sourcing, respondendo pelo desenvolvimento e evolução da equipe e dos processos como um todo.

- MANDATÓRIO PARA ESTA OPORTUNIDADE

  • Disponibilidade para residir em SC (Vale do Itajaí);
  • Já ter atuado com a gestão da área de sourcing em empresas do segmento têxtil ou no varejo (neste caso, com o sourcing em categorias ligadas ao têxtil, acessórios, decorações, outros);
  • Mandatório ter experiência com sourcing internacional;
  • Inglês em nível avançado ou fluente.

- MODELO DE ATUAÇÃO

  • Contratação CLT;
  • Modelo presencial, com viagens constantes.

title: Coordenador de Garantia da Qualidade
description:
Descrição da empresa

Como um importante player global em levedura e fermentação, a Lesaffre projeta, fabrica e comercializa soluções inovadoras para panificação, sabor e prazer de alimentos, saúde e biotecnologia.
Grupo familiar nascido no norte da França em 1853, hoje Lesaffre é uma empresa multinacional e multicultural comprometida em trabalhar com confiança para melhor nutrir e proteger o planeta.
Em estreita colaboração com seus clientes e parceiros, a Lesaffre emprega 11.000 pessoas em cerca de 80 subsidiárias localizadas em mais de 50 países.
A Lesaffre atinge um volume de negócios de 2.200 milhões de euros.

Descrição da vaga

Coordenar atividades de Garantia da Qualidade e garantir a segurança alimentar, conformidade adequada e certificação necessária para desenvolver o negócio. Responsável pela Garantia da Qualidade das operações da Lesaffre do Brasil (importação + plantas) e suas unidades de negócios (BUs) e seus Assuntos Regulatórios.

Qualificações

  1. Formação superior em Engenharia Química, Alimentos ou áreas correlatas.
  2. Desejável Pós-graduação, MBA ou Mestrado nas áreas de Qualidade.
  3. Formação ou experiência comprovada com sistemas de gestão de qualidade e auditorias.
  4. Desejável vivência em sistemas de gestão (FSSC 22000, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, OHSAS 18001/ISO 45001, SMETA) e certificações religiosas Halal/Kosher.
  5. Experiência comprovada de 8 anos em gestão de equipes (5 anos em cargos semelhantes) na implementação de Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade e Assuntos Regulatórios.

Informações adicionais

  1. Conhecimento sólido em sistemas de gestão da qualidade em segurança alimentar e assuntos regulatórios.
  2. Vivência direta com normas, regulamentos e requisitos legais aplicáveis à indústria de alimentos. Processos e tecnologias de produção na indústria alimentícia. Análise de riscos e implementação de medidas de controle. Métodos de amostragem, análise e interpretação de dados. Ferramentas de melhoria contínua (PDCA, 5S, Lean, etc.).
  3. Capacidade de análise crítica, tomada de decisão, melhoria contínua, habilidades de liderança, comunicação, trabalho em equipe e resolução de problemas complexos.
  4. Habilidade e didática para construção de conteúdo para treinamento e desenvolvimento de equipes.
  5. Disponibilidade para mudança na região de Presidente Prudente/SP e viagens nacionais e internacionais.
  6. Inglês fluente mandatório e desejável espanhol intermediário.
  7. Se estrangeiro, conhecimento básico do idioma Português.

Vaga 100% presencial.

title: Técnico de refrigeração
description:
Somos uma empresa em movimento. Isso se traduz em nossa busca por profissionais que não tenham medo do desconhecido, que almejem novos desafios e aprendizados. Aqui, valorizamos a responsabilidade e o compromisso frente a situações que fogem da zona de conforto, pois acreditamos que esse é o caminho para o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional.

Esperamos que o colaborador demonstre proatividade e capacidade de identificar oportunidades de melhorias no setor, reconheça a Thermomatic como um ambiente propício para sugestões construtivas e que proporcione um espaço onde cada voz é valorizada, contribuindo assim para o crescimento coletivo da equipe.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar manutenções preventivas em sistemas de HVAC, garantindo o funcionamento eficiente e contínuo dos equipamentos de refrigeração, ventilação e ar condicionado.
  • Diagnosticar problemas em sistemas de refrigeração e HVAC, identificando e corrigindo falhas de maneira ágil e eficaz.
  • Efetuar manutenções corretivas, incluindo a substituição de peças danificadas, reparos em componentes elétricos e mecânicos, e ajustes em sistemas de controle.
  • Montar e instalar equipamentos de HVAC, seguindo especificações técnicas e assegurando a correta instalação de sistemas de refrigeração, ventilação e ar condicionado.
  • Ajustar componentes e realizar testes após a montagem, garantindo que os equipamentos estejam funcionando conforme os padrões de qualidade e segurança.
  • Registrar todas as atividades realizadas em relatórios técnicos, garantindo a rastreabilidade e o acompanhamento do desempenho dos sistemas.
  • Garantir que os procedimentos de segurança sejam seguidos rigorosamente durante todas as atividades de manutenção e montagem.
  • Lançar orçamento dos relatórios de conserto (RC’s) no sistema.
  • Atender junto ao SAC sempre que for necessária orientação técnica.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos prazos, de forma a garantir o padrão de atendimento da empresa junto aos clientes.

Qualificações

  • Curso técnico em refrigeração concluído ou superior em curso - Engenharia mecânica ou áreas correlatas.

  • Regime de contratação CLT
  • Restaurante na empresa, café da manhã e almoço

  • Plano odontológico SulAmérica custeado 100% pela Thermo

  • Dayoff no aniversário

About the project:

These proactive searches align with the profiles our trusted clients seek regularly. Join our "Future Talent" network to be among the first considered when the right opportunity arises.

With over 160 new hires every year, we are constantly expanding our team with passionate and skilled professionals who want to make an impact.

As a Change Management Lead , you will design and drive training, onboarding, communication strategies, and stakeholder engagement plans. You will work closely with Program Managers, Release Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth transitions and high levels of adoption for system, process, and cultural changes.

How your day-to-day work will look like:

  • Apply a deep understanding of organizational change management principles, particularly Prosci and the ADKAR model, to drive successful change initiatives.
  • Develop and execute stakeholder engagement strategies and resistance management practices to ensure smooth transitions.
  • Lead enterprise communication planning by crafting effective messages, targeting key groups, and assessing communication impact.
  • Design and implement training and onboarding programs that align with business objectives to enhance adoption.
  • Oversee program lifecycle management, incorporating agile or hybrid delivery models to optimize execution.
  • Drive cultural transformation efforts within enterprises, leveraging telecom sector knowledge or previous large-scale experience.
  • Design and drive training, onboarding, communication strategies, and stakeholder engagement plans.
  • Collaborate closely with Program Managers, Release Managers, and other stakeholders to facilitate smooth transitions.
  • Ensure high levels of adoption for system, process, and cultural changes.

This would make you the ideal candidate:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ Years of experience in Change Management or Business Transformation.
  • Proven application of Prosci methodology and ADKAR framework in enterprise settings (preferably), PMP/PMI also applicable.
  • Solid experience in telecommunications or leading cultural change programs in large organizations.
  • Expertise in planning and executing training, onboarding, and communications for varied stakeholder groups.
  • Ability to collaborate closely with Program Managers, Release Managers, and cross-functional teams to ensure consistent messaging and smooth adoption.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

What to expect from our Talent Connection process:

  • Sign up: Apply to this position and upload your resume.
  • Profile review: Our team will review your profile and keep it in our talent database.
  • Contact: Our team will contact you to have an interview to get to know you better and to share with you a bit more of what we are looking for.
  • Knowing you better: We'd love to discuss your experience in an interview with our recruiters.
  • Notification: When a suitable position opens, we’ll contact you to start the selection process, having in mind that this process will be faster because we already had the first screening.

Transparency: This process is direct and without intermediaries.

Banco de Talentos de Professores SP - Venha trabalhar na Escola Eleva São Paulo!

São Paulo, BR

Este é um Banco de Talentos de Professores para a Escola Eleva São Paulo. A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Se juntando a nós como professor(a), sua missão principal será lecionar para nossos alunos, estimulando o desenvolvimento deles com cuidado, responsabilidade e entusiasmo!

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas da matéria alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de licenciatura na matéria da sua área ou de Pedagogia ou Normal se tiver interesse em posição de Regente para Infantil ou Fundamental 1.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

description:
Kaizen Gaming, the team powering Betano, is one of the biggest GameTech companies in the world, operating in 19 markets.We always aim to leverage cutting-edge technology, providing the best experience to our millions of customers who trust us for their entertainment.

We are a diverse team of more than 2.700 Kaizeners, from 40+ nationalities spreading across 3 continents. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation,or age.

Our #oneteam is proud to be among the Best Workplaces in Europe and certified Great Place to Work across our offices. Here, there’ll be no average day for you. Ready to Press Play on Potential?

Let’s start with the role

We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Principal Database Administrator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing our MS SQL Server environments, with a strong focus on availability, security, and performance. You will play a key role in ensuring the continuous operation of our databases, particularly in complex, high-availability scenarios such as Availability Groups. In addition, you will bring your knowledge of alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB, as well as your expertise in cloud-based database administration.

As a Principal Database Administrator, you will:

  • Provide comprehensive day-to-day support, monitoring, troubleshooting, and administration for multiple MS SQL databases, with a particular focus on high-availability configurations like Availability Groups.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex performance and availability issues, with in-depth root cause analysis to prevent future occurrences.
  • Oversee database maintenance processes, including performance tuning , index management, and job automation, ensuring optimal operation.
  • Develop and enforce policies for backup and recovery , ensuring database resilience and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Apply security patches , conduct version upgrades, and enforce strict compliance with database security best practices.
  • Handle support calls and resolve technical issues swiftly, including response to security incidents and operational challenges.
  • Leverage expertise in alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB to contribute to cross-functional database projects.
  • Manage and optimize cloud-based database environments , ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability in cloud infrastructure.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Solidhands-on experience in MS SQL Server Database Administration in production environments.
  • Extensive experience with MS SQL Server database features, including Jobs Scheduling, Monitoring, Patching, Backup/Recovery, Replication, Availability Groups , and Always On configurations.
  • Proven expertise in diagnosing and resolving performance bottlenecks and availability issues .
  • Solid understanding of alternative database engines like PostgreSQL , MongoDB and CockroachDB , with practical experience in their administration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in cloud database administration , with experience in cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Fluency in English , both written and verbal, with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities, alongside a proactive approach to continuous learning.
  • A commitment to mentoring and supporting junior team members.

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. A John Deere é líder global no fornecimento de produtos, tecnologia e serviços avançados para clientes que atuam na agricultura, construção, florestal, entre outros setores. This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until a sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

If the position allows for flexible working:

At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools, and environment you need to be successful. description:
Join our Brazil Country Finance team as a manager in our Sao Paulo office. The Country Finance function is part of Macquarie Finance Management Group and focused on the financial control, financial reporting, financial compliance, and legal entity control of Macquarie Group subsidiaries in Brazil.

At Macquarie, our advantage is bringing together diverse people and empowering them to shape all kinds of possibilities. We are a global financial services group operating in 34 markets and with 55 years of unbroken profitability. You’ll be part of a friendly and supportive team where everyone - no matter what role - contributes ideas and drives outcomes.

  • Expertise in performing regular compliance activities which form part of ongoing monitoring and control – monthly financial review of entity balances, attestation of all Legal Entity owned balances, impairment reviews, preparation of financial reports for Board Meetings

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.

In our Financial Management Group you will work in the financial hub of Macquarie, driving real change for our businesses. title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Machine Learning Engineer role at Techunting

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who dares to work with cutting-edge technology! It involves inspiring yourself with state-of-the-art research papers to help with the Machine Learning model design, implementation, training, and deployment. You will be responsible for applying the best MLOps practices and principles to the whole modeling workflow. It will require you to gain great insight into the problems, conceive how data can be exploited, and how new concepts can be created. This role enables you to apply novel ideas that can change the world, while learning a lot at the same time!

Main responsibilities and duties:

  1. Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in machine learning by exploring and drawing insights from state-of-the-art research papers. Leverage this knowledge to design and develop innovative machine learning models tailored to our specific needs.
  2. Translate conceptual models into practical implementations, utilizing programming languages and machine learning frameworks. Train and fine-tune models to achieve optimal performance and accuracy.
  3. Drive the deployment process of machine learning models into production environments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth integration and scalability of the models.
  4. Apply the best MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) practices and principles throughout the entire modeling workflow. Streamline processes for efficient development, testing, and deployment of machine learning solutions.
  5. Dive deep into problem domains to gain a comprehensive understanding of challenges and opportunities. Analyze and preprocess data to extract valuable insights for model improvement.
  6. Propose and experiment with novel ideas and approaches to tackle complex problems. Explore creative ways to leverage data and develop new concepts that could potentially revolutionize the field.
  7. Collaborate with a team of skilled professionals, including data scientists, engineers, and domain experts. Foster a collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing and continuous learning.

Qualifications and Skills:

  1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software or Electrical Engineering, or comparable professional experience in Machine Learning related areas.
  2. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  3. Experience working with native ML orchestration systems such as Kubeflow, Step Functions, MLflow, Airflow, and TFX.
  4. Experience in technologies like Spark, Kafka, Spark streaming, Flink, etc.
  5. Expertise in MLOps and model integration into larger-scale applications.
  6. Experience with implementing and scaling feature stores across organizations.
  7. Strong programming skills in Python and experience with popular machine learning libraries/frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  8. Expertise in using Docker and Kubernetes.
  9. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to analyze and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  10. Ability to read, interpret, and apply research papers in machine learning. A strong grasp of foundational machine learning concepts is essential.
  11. Knowledge of agile methodologies and ability to work in a fast-paced and evolving environment. Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies.

We are looking for a skilled Director, Engineering Lead to manage an important big mobile project for a 70,000+ people company.

The Global Communications team at TikTok is responsible for all external communications related to the company. At TikTok, our leaders are also doers and you have proven experience conceptualizing, planning, and executing projects that have meaningful business impact. As a strategic leader, you will work closely with other teams across the Global Brand & Comms department, including Marketing and CSR, as well as with our cross-functional partners — Product, Legal and Public Policy —to create cohesive and compelling communication strategies.
Ideal candidates are resilient, entrepreneurial-minded leaders who work well in an ever-evolving environment. You have strong media relationships. You collaborate with ease across teams and are able to weigh big picture objectives with immediate business needs. You're good at connecting the dots and you thrive in an entrepreneurial environment. And you lead with a compassionate, people-first mindset. This role reports to the Head of Global Corporate Communications.

- Advance the team's business objectives and enhance and protect corporate reputation in support of building our brand.

- Create and lead strategies to effectively identify and mitigate early-stage crises while also effectively managing other potential risks to the company.
- Identify strategic priorities across the region aligned with cross-functional partners and mapped to overall business objectives.
- Work closely with teams, such as Public Policy and CSR, to develop and implement strategic communications plans that amplify how TikTok is enabling progress for businesses and communities.
- Lead and develop a high-performing team, while fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous development.
Qualifications

- Extensive communications experience and a deep knowledge of consumer, business, and trade/vertical media in the region.
- Able to diplomatically handle change and exhibit sound judgment.
- Demonstrated experience in influencing stakeholders, resolving complex problems and ensuring collaboration within teams and across cross-functional disciplines.
- Proven ability to mentor and inspire high-performing teams across multiple geographies in region.
- Excellent strategic, analytical, and verbal communication skills.
- Previous experience working for a global company is strongly preferred.
- Must be fluent in English & Portuguese. Given the regional LATAM scope, Spanish would be a plus.
About ByteDance Brazil
ByteDance is a global incubator of platforms at the cutting edge of commerce, content, entertainment, and enterprise services - over 2.5 billion people interact with ByteDance products, including TikTok.

Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.
Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

You will act as a key business partner to a sales or customer success leader of an assigned region or segment. In this role, you will help develop the GTM enablement strategy aligned with the business priorities, OKRs and local needs of your GTM stakeholders. This person will own the strategic end-to-end enablement plan and calendar, to design, deliver and track enablement programs to accelerate talent development across products, industry or segment knowledge, and role-based competencies, that lead to better customer conversations and revenue growth.
This position is an individual contributor reporting to Sr. Director, NA/LATAM GTM Enablement Business Partners and Trainer.
Responsibility

  • Partner with sales and GTM leadership to understand strategic objectives, business goals, priorities, and performance targets
  • Translate strategic objectives into quarterly enablement plans that address skill, process, and execution gaps
  • Collaborate with regional sales leaders and frontline managers to identify specific team or individual performance gaps
  • Build and execute customized enablement plans (where needed) tied to performance outcomes, not just learning completion
  • Coach frontline managers on how to drive and reinforce performance within their teams
  • Serve as the main enablement point of contact for the GTM team you support
  • Design and deliver targeted training programs for GTM teams (AEs, CSMs, SEs) based on business needs
  • Facilitate live and virtual training sessions, deal clinics, role plays, and workshops focused on skill development (e.g., discovery, negotiation, objection handling, value selling, adoption amp; renewal)

  • Create and deliver big deal management courses to elevate the skill set of our Enterprise teams to engage, educate, influence and close larger Enterprise deals
  • Act as a strategic feedback loop to the Enablement, Product, and GTM Ops teams by sharing insights from the field
  • Recommend and iterate on enablement programs (even onboarding) based on performance data, rep feedback, and market changes
  • Collaborate with Enablement Operations and Ops analytics teams to track impact of enablement initiatives on KPIs (e.g., win rate, pipeline coverage, deal velocity)
  • Partner with Global Enablement Program Managers, product marketing, product, and GTM operations to ensure GTM initiatives are supported with enablement programs that drive execution
  • Work with your global enablement program manager to build any enablement plans or programs as well help prioritize content creation for the PM, making recommendations and supporting them where needed
  • Collaborate with and share ideas with your fellow Enablement Business Partners to ensure consistency in training on functions in your GTM teams
  • Ensure training is aligned to current product messaging, ICP shifts, and go-to-market motions you support
  • Align with global enablement content teams, product marketing, and ops teams to ensure enablement plans support launches, sales plays, and GTM campaigns

We are looking for a business savvy Sr. Product Manager to drive our payments initiatives in Brazil and create access to affordable payment methods. You will own the vision and roadmap to scale our digital payment products and work with global teams to support launches and management of new products.

The right candidate possesses a strong product/program management background, a deep understanding of BR Payments and financial/credit products competitive landscape, and demonstrated experience leading large projects. You will be responsible for product roadmap and development life-cycle, from working backwards from our Customers to define the vision for what is required to make the product launch and program successful in Brazil. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities to scale a business in a new geography.   1. Partner with key local and global stakeholders to work on ongoing and upcoming initiatives;

  5. Lead external partner relations: manage partner performance and customer experience, set objectives and success criteria, and drive towards operational excellence;
  6. Drive product awareness and adoption: identify marketing opportunities and support the delivery of effective marketing campaigns with internal and external partners;
  7. Lead the day-to-day operations: assess and manage risks, monitor and report on progress with actionable insights, anticipate and resolve bottlenecks, and provide escalation management.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end-to-end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and trade-offs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data-driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

Job description

O que faz a área de Transformação, Clientes e Orquestrador na Porto?

A área de Transformação, Cliente e Orquestrador tem como principal objetivo promover mudanças significativas na organização, visando otimizar processos, melhorar a experiência e satisfação do cliente e do corretor, bem como aumentar a competitividade da empresa. Essa área atua como um catalisador de transformação, impulsionando a inovação e a excelência operacional.


Main responsibilities

  • Realizar diagnóstico detalhado da jornada do cliente e corretor, identificando pontos de atrito, oportunidades de melhoria e gaps nos processos atuais, conectados com os objetivos estratégicos da Diretoria.
  • Criar experiências intuitivas e eficientes nos canais digitais e humanos em parceria com as áreas de design e tecnologia.
  • Desenvolver planos de mudança, a fim de definir e estruturar ações necessárias para alcançar os objetivos de transformação, mitigando os impactos na experiência do cliente e corretor.
  • Desenvolver estratégias, elaborar e implementar planos de comunicação eficazes para informar sobre as mudanças e impactos encontrados nas alterações dos processos financeiros para colaboradores, clientes e corretores.
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos para capacitar os colaboradores a utilizarem as novas ferramentas e processos, além de promover a mudança cultural necessária.
  • Promover o engajamento das pessoas impactadas, garantindo a compreensão das mudanças.
  • Monitorar a implementação das mudanças, coletar feedbacks e realizar ajustes conforme necessário, garantindo o sucesso das iniciativas e a melhoria contínua da experiência.
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas e indicadores para medir o progresso, desafios e sucessos das iniciativas de mudanças realizada frente ao público envolvido.
  • Manter a documentação atualizada de todos os processos e atividades de gestão de mudanças.
  • Produzir materiais e garantir os prazos dos combinados de maneira executiva.
  • Liderar e gerir pessoas e processos, centralizado no desenvolvimento e resultado.

Requirements and skills

  • Imprescindível: Sólida experiência em gestão de mudança e projetos de transformação digital, com foco em melhoria da experiência do cliente. Além de projetos de implementação de CRM e ferramentas de Autoatendimento;
  • Certificações em Metodologias de Gestão de Processos (BPMN, Lean, Six Sigma), em Metodologias Ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) ou em UX Design.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (MS Project, Asana); ferramentas de desenho de processos; softwares de análise de dados (Power BI, Tableau) e metodologias de gestão de mudanças como Prosci ADKAR;

title: Director - Principal Research Scientist - AI & Optimization
description:
At Franklin Templeton, we’re advancing our industry forward by developing new and innovative ways to help our clients achieve their investment goals. Our dynamic and diversified firm spans asset management, wealth management, and fintech, offering many ways to help investors make progress toward their goals. Our talented teams working around the globe bring expertise that’s both broad and unique. From our welcoming, inclusive, and flexible culture to our global and diverse business, we provide opportunities to help you reach your potential while helping our clients reach theirs.

Come join us in delivering better outcomes for our clients around the world!

This is a HYBRID position, currently requiring 3 days per week in one of our offices.

What is the FTT AI & Digital Transformation Team responsible for?

The FTT AI & Digital Transformation group is a newly established team within Franklin Templeton Technologies, the technology function within Franklin Templeton Investments

What is the Director - Principal Research Scientist – AI & Optimization responsible for?

The core mandate of this role is to bring innovative digital investment products and solutions to market, leveraging a patented and innovative digital WealthTech/FinTech product - Goals Optimization Engine (GOE) - built with several years of academic research in mathematical optimization, probability theory and AI techniques at its core. The mandate also extends to leveraging cutting edge AI, such as Generative AI, in addition to Reactive AI to create value within various business functions within Franklin Templeton such as Investment Solutions, Portfolio Management, Sales & Distribution, Marketing, and HR functions, among others, in a responsible and appropriate manner. The possibilities are limitless here and present a fantastic opportunity for a self-motivated and driven professional to make significant contributions to the organization and to themselves.

What are the ongoing responsibilities of a Director - Principal Research Scientist – AI & Optimization?

As a Principal Research Scientist - AI and Optimization, you will play a pivotal role in driving innovation, product research, and proof of concepts for our AI research and Goals Optimization Engine (GOE) product roadmap. You will be responsible for mentoring and guiding a team of highly motivated research scientists, creating intellectual property, and ensuring successful client deployments and product development.

Key Responsibilities:

Innovation, Product Research, Proof of Concepts, Pseudocode & Design (40%):

  • Lead and contribute to the multi-year Goals Optimization Engine (GOE) product roadmap, conceptualizing fitment against various industry use cases, creating product variants, and designing new features and enhancements across multiple distribution lines and geographies

  • Mentor and guide a team of research scientists to achieve common objectives

  • Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for a specific domain within AI and/or Optimization, acting as the go-to person for all internal stakeholders

  • Develop pseudocode and working prototypes in a Python environment, collaborating closely with Product Managers and Product Developers

  • Create well-articulated design documents and presentations to explain research to internal and external stakeholders, including clients and partners located globally

  • Lead industry research and evaluate partnerships with third-party vendors and specialized service providers where appropriate

  • Maintain a thorough understanding of boundary conditions, regulatory environments, data challenges, technology integrations, algorithmic dependencies, and operational process nuances to ensure nothing slips through the cracks

  • Stay up to date with the latest developments in the Investment Management industry, Financial Mathematics, Portfolio Construction, and Portfolio Management

IP Creation, Paper Writing, and Thought Leadership (30%):

  • Conceptualize and produce high-quality intellectual property for publication in top-tier academic and practitioner journals

  • Peer-review the work of other research scientists and improve the outcome of their research output

  • Create patent-worthy intellectual content, apply for patents, and win them

  • Take responsibility for winning industry awards for exceptional product research and innovative work products

  • Stay informed about the latest industry research and evaluate it objectively and in an unbiased manner

  • Publish research works for conferences

Client Deployment, Product Development, and Vendor Due Diligence (30%):

  • Act as the SME in initial client deployment discussions, showcasing the rigor of research, explaining the product or solution concept, and engaging in discussions with similar individuals/teams from the client/partner side

  • Contribute to product development by ensuring alignment with research and design

  • Provide hands-on support where required to complete time-critical work successfully

  • Engage with third-party vendors and potential integration partners to understand their capabilities, methodologies, and algorithms, and perform rigorous due diligence to make clear recommendations on Go/No-Go decisions

What ideal qualifications, skills & experience would help someone to be successful?

Education:

  • Bachelor's and Master's degree in STEM disciplines; a PhD in a relevant discipline (Optimization, Probability, Quant Finance, AI & ML, Computational Mathematics, Statistics, etc.) would be a +

  • Relevant industry certifications

Experience - Core Skills:

  • 10+ years of applied R &D experience in research departments of reputed organizations post-Masters or PhD

  • Track record of real innovation generating impact is essential

  • Demonstrated ability to create intellectual content, publish papers, and obtain patents

  • Ability to effectively bridge the gap between academia and practice, ensuring research is practical and implementable

  • Structured thinking and exceptional mathematical skills

  • Excellent team player with the ability to work with ambiguity and thrive in chaos

  • Familiarity with ML/DL/DRL, NLP, especially Large Language Models, dynamic programming, and/or convex optimization

  • Solid experience with AWS and/or Azure

  • Familiar with Python, PySpark, SQL, Hadoop, C++

Experience - Other Soft Skills:

  • Proven ability to take initiative and work under pressure in a changing, fast paced environment

  • Exceptional decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize across needs given limited resources

  • Thrives in a startup-like environment: loves dealing with a fast pace and changing needs

  • Ability to build relationships both inside and outside of the product organization

  • Ability to narrate a story for a problem along with the capacity to dive into minute details

  • Superlative communication and consensus-building skills

  1. Assessorar a Direção Geral em assuntos médicos, atinente o serviço contratado;

  4. Supervisionar a execução das atividades de assistência médica do serviço, como responsável técnico e coordenador da área;
  5. Promover a revisão dos “Protocolos Clínicos” implantados e/ou implantar novos, de acordo com a necessidade assistencial, visando o melhor desempenho da UTI e demais profissionais de saúde em benefício dos pacientes, propiciando a padronização e a sistematização das condutas, minimizando a variabilidade dos processos assistenciais e a solicitação de exames e procedimentos desnecessários;
  6.   7. Promover junto a equipe a continuidade dos cuidados diários;
  8. Manter contato constante com o Diretor Técnico do Hospital para fins de prestar informações sobre a assistência prestada e andamento do setor;
  9. Fiscalizar as escalas de trabalho das equipes médicas lotadas no serviço de UTI, zelando para que não existam lacunas durante o período de atendimento/funcionamento. Em caso de ausência de profissional, deverá corrigir imediatamente a lacuna e comunicar imediatamente o Diretor Técnico, que participará da tomada de providências necessária para solucionar o caso com a máxima brevidade;
  10. Emitir relatórios/pareceres técnicos quando solicitados pela Diretoria Geral;
  11. Controlar os processos de rotina assistencial do serviço contratado;
  12. Contribuir e assegurar que boas condições de trabalho sejam implementadas e seguidas na rotina diária de trabalho;
  13. Assegurar a eficiência e segurança de todos os procedimentos realizados na unidade de terapia intensiva;
  14. Deverá preencher a avaliação clínica diária, enquanto atuar como plantonista, cuidar e zelar pelo devido uso do prontuário médico estabelecido pelo hospital contratante;
  15. Cobrir as intercorrências durante o seu plantão.

Coordenadora Pedagógica | Educação por Princípios | Zona Leste SP

Vaga: Coordenador(a) Pedagógico(a) – Educação Infantil e Ensino Fundamental

Sobre a Instituição

Com mais de quatro décadas de atuação na zona leste de São Paulo, nossa instituição tem como missão formar gerações com propósito, valores cristãos e excelência acadêmica . Trabalhamos com uma proposta pedagógica que vai além do conteúdo, focando no desenvolvimento do ser por meio da Educação por Princípios (AEP) .

Missão do Cargo

A missão do Coordenador(a) Pedagógico(a) é liderar o projeto pedagógico com visão cristã, promovendo o desenvolvimento acadêmico, emocional e espiritual dos alunos, acompanhando e orientando professores em práticas que integrem os 7 princípios da AEP ao cotidiano escolar.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Coordenar o planejamento pedagógico com base na Educação por Princípios , promovendo coerência entre ensino, valores e propósito.
  • Orientar a equipe docente com base nos princípios bíblicos aplicados à prática pedagógica.
  • Conduzir reuniões, formações e momentos de alinhamento com amor, escuta ativa e autoridade espiritual e técnica.
  • Mediar conflitos e demandas com as famílias, mantendo postura cristã, acolhedora e resolutiva.
  • Estimular a excelência acadêmica integrada ao desenvolvimento de caráter.
  • Monitorar e analisar os resultados pedagógicos da escola com intencionalidade e visão de futuro.

Competências Comportamentais Esperadas

  • Amor a Deus e compromisso com os valores cristãos
  • Liderança empática e firme, com espírito de serviço
  • Comunicação acolhedora, clara e respeitosa
  • Visão estratégica, organização e planejamento
  • Habilidade para formar, motivar e inspirar a equipe docente

Competências Técnicas Necessárias

  • Licenciatura em Pedagogia (obrigatório)
  • Conhecimento da BNCC e diretrizes para Educação Infantil e Fundamental
  • Experiência anterior em coordenação pedagógica
  • Domínio de gestão de equipe e acompanhamento docente
  • Facilidade com tecnologias educacionais e sistemas de gestão escolar

Diferenciais Valorizados

  • Pós-graduação em Gestão Escolar, Coordenação Pedagógica ou áreas afins
  • Experiência com a AEP (Abordagem Educacional por Princípios)
  • Vivência com escolas cristãs ou confessionais
  • Conhecimento prático dos 7 princípios bíblicos : Caráter, Mordomia, Semeadura e Colheita, Individualidade, Autogoverno, Aliança e Soberania
  • Experiência com metodologias ativas e avaliação formativa
  • Residir na zona leste de São Paulo

  • Modalidade: CLT

  • Modelo de trabalho: Presencial

description:
Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include major public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering, passionate about open source software, Linux, and cloud computing. This role involves leading a regional team, supporting continuous improvement of open source software by resolving customer-reported defects across the software stack, from kernel to user space applications and IaaS platforms. The team is well-resourced to ensure work-life balance and professional development.

Your primary responsibilities include supporting your team’s growth, technical leadership, influencing culture, and collaborating on strategy and execution.

Location:

This is a globally remote role unless otherwise specified.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Manage and lead a distributed engineering team.
  2. Hire, coach, mentor, and provide career development guidance.
  3. Manage KPIs and training initiatives.
  4. Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and technical solutions across various technologies including Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju, and MAAS.
  5. Represent Canonical positively in customer interactions.
  6. Set expectations with other teams, management, and external stakeholders.
  7. Promote modern software development practices.
  8. Foster a healthy, collaborative engineering culture aligned with company values.
  9. Collaborate with other organizational teams.
  10. Work remotely with up to 10% travel for internal and external events.

Qualifications:

  • Experience in software delivery using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar.
  • Passion for software development.
  • Leadership experience in complex problem resolution and bug fixes.
  • Experience with version control systems like git.
  • Proficiency with debugging tools such as gdb or crash.
  • Strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code.
  • Excellent English communication skills.
  • Experience with Linux, preferably Ubuntu.
  • Knowledge of Open Source and its business models.
  • People management experience in support organizations is a plus.

What We Offer:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints.
  • USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget.
  • Annual compensation review and recognition rewards.
  • Generous leave policies, including maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Travel opportunities to meet colleagues.
  • Travel upgrades for company events.

About Canonical:

Canonical is at the forefront of open source innovation, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We hire globally and uphold high standards of excellence. Working remotely since 2004, we promote a forward-thinking, inclusive workplace.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and fairness in hiring.
